about.title: About Blockbright
about.what: Blockbright is a free learning app that teaches young people how crypto works and how to stay safe. It uses simulations only: no real money, no real wallets, no real tokens.
about.notAdvice: Blockbright is education, not financial advice. It never tells you to buy, sell or hold anything. Real crypto platforms require you to be 18 or older.
about.privacy: Blockbright has no accounts and collects no personal data. Your progress and settings are saved only in your own browser, and nothing is sent anywhere. Clearing your browser data or pressing "Reset my progress" deletes it.
about.publisher: Published by a private individual in Finland. Contact details will be added before launch.
about.noAds: No ads, no trackers, no tokens. Free forever.

rules.title: Golden rules
rules.subtitle: Seven rules that keep your coins safe
rules.cardText: Seven rules to print or keep
rules.footer: Blockbright · Practice only, not financial advice
rules.printHint: In the print window, choose "Save as PDF" to download the card.

r1.title: Your seed phrase is yours alone.
r1.text: Never type it into a website, chat or form, and never show it to anyone, not even "support".

r2.title: Free money is a trap.
r2.text: No one doubles your coins. Giveaways that ask you to send or connect first are scams.

r3.title: Slow down when you feel pushed.
r3.text: Pressure, secrecy and countdowns are red flags. A real chance does not vanish in ten minutes.

r4.title: Check the address, then check again.
r4.text: Compare the first and last characters and send a small test first. A sent transaction is final.

r5.title: Only use what you can afford to lose.
r5.text: Prices can fall fast. Never borrow money to buy crypto.

r6.title: Go to the source yourself.
r6.text: Type the address of the site or open the official app. Do not trust links in messages.

r7.title: Talk to someone you trust.
r7.text: Before your first real step, or when something feels wrong, ask a parent or another adult you trust.
